title: Meet Kiran Reddy, 18-year-old Georgia teen who became the first Indian American to win Miss Teen USA
summary_full: Kiran Reddy has made an outstanding mark as the first Indian American crowned Miss Teen USA. Having previously claimed the Miss Georgia Teen USA title, she is celebrated as Georgia's first national winner. A dedicated pre-medical student, Reddy aspires to inspire young girls. She is set to represent the United States at the Miss Teen Universe contest, alongside continuing her academic journey.
